block_model.local_object: one parity half of Match(K4,4) = A4 torsor

reproducibility: Large records are regenerated deterministically by the committed Pass-2553 workers from frozen repository inputs; theorem-bearing counts and record SHA-256 values are frozen here.
theorem: Each of the 45 canonical twelve-frame imprimitivity blocks is attached to an omitted geometric K4,4 on eight W33 points. Its twelve frames induce exactly one parity half of the 24 perfect matchings of that K4,4, hence form an A4 torsor. Relation 16 is equality of the three V4 cosets in A4, giving three K4 graphs, while relation 13 joins distinct cosets, giving K4,4,4; their union is K12.
